title: Design System: MILAN: Monitored Incident & Log Audit Node

display.purpose: The single H1; self-hosted Archivo, tight negative tracking.

title.purpose: Case-card title in Archivo; section H3s use the body face.

body.purpose: All prose and UI copy in the system sans.

label.purpose: Identifiers, commands, inline code, and data cells in mono.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Anchor navigation scrolls smoothly; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Hero and two-column grids collapse to one column.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Body type, container inset, header, sections, and evidence rows tighten.

components.css: .ds-case { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 22px 24px 20px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-case-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding-bottom: 12px; } .ds-case-id { font: 600 14px/1 var(--font-mono); } .ds-case-kind { font: 13px/1.4 var(--font-body); color: var(--muted); } .ds-case-title { font: 600 1.15rem/1.3 var(--font-display); letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 14px 0 10px; } .ds-verdict { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-verdict-word { font: 700 1.6rem/1 var(--font-display); color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: -0.03em; } .ds-verdict-detail { font: 13px/1.4 var(--font-body); color: var(--muted); } .ds-evidence { margin: 0; } .ds-evidence > div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 118px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-evidence dt { font: 13px/1.4 var(--font-body); color: var(--muted); } .ds-evidence dd { margin: 0; font: 13px/1.4 var(--font-mono); color: var(--ink); overflow-wrap: break-word; min-width: 0; } .ds-gate { margin-top: 18px; } .ds-gate-state { font: 600 13px/1.4 var(--font-body); margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-gate-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 12px 0; font: 14px/1.6 var(--font-body); } .ds-pending { font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-mono); color: var(--accent); }

narrative.overview:
MILAN's documentation reads as a case file, not a product landing page. A warm paper ground, hairline ink-grey rules, and one white case card make the page behave like a reproducible report: a verdict, a short evidence list, and a containment gate paused for a person. Density is calm and forensic — generous vertical rhythm between ruled sections, tight monospaced data inside the card. The confirmed visual rejection is the eyebrow/numbered-list SaaS template; nothing in the build uses kickers, pills, decorative badges, or shadows.

Personality is plain and human. Colour is almost entirely ink on paper, with one brick-red signal reserved for the moments that need attention — a verdict, a pending action, a link, a focus ring. The self-hosted Archivo face carries every heading with tight negative tracking, the system sans carries prose, and a system mono carries identifiers, commands, and data cells. All assets are local and the system needs no build step, so it stays legible offline.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (#f4f3ee) with a single white surface step and 1px hairline rules for all structure.
Archivo display headings, system-sans body, system-mono for identifiers and data.
A case-file signature: ruled case header, verdict, definition-list evidence, and a paused HITL gate with two pending actions.
Flat and square: no shadows, no radius, no icon glyphs.
One container (1120px), one responsive pair of breakpoints (900px, 560px), reduced-motion honored.

rules.name: The Brick-Red-Is-Signal Rule
rules.body: Accent is never a field or decoration. It appears only on verdicts, pending states, links, focus, caret, selection, and hover — the moments asking for attention.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Every boundary is one pixel of line, never a shadow, gradient, or colour block.

rules.name: The Mono-for-Data Rule
rules.body: Mono is reserved for identifiers, commands, inline code, and data cells. Prose and headings never use it, and nothing is uppercased for tracking.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest and in every state. Never introduce shadows, glows, or tonal layering beyond the single paper/white step; use a hairline rule to separate.

dos: Do centre content in the 1120px container using min(calc(100% - 48px), 1120px), tightening to a 16px inset at ≤560px.
Do build structure from 1px line rules and the paper/white step, keeping accent on signal only.
Do set display headings in Archivo with negative tracking, prose in the system sans, and identifiers/data in mono.
Do keep surfaces flat and square, and render numeric values in tabular figures.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion and keep the page navigable without JavaScript.
donts: Don't add border-radius, pills, shadows, glows, or gradient fills.
Don't use brick red as a large field or background; it is a signal colour, not a ground.
Don't set body copy in mono or set display headings in a system font.
Don't fill case-file or table cells with placeholder values; displayed records must stay checkable.
